author: kirubaharan181
description: Use when work is about to be called done: sets completion criteria and closes on evidence. Do NOT use to plan or do the work.
purpose: Makes completion mean accepted behavior with evidence, not finished activity. It selects the completion profile for the task (code, API, database, infrastructure, security fix, release, incident or documentation), checks the criteria, records exceptions with owners, and refuses to close work with unowned open risk.
when_to_use: A task is about to be reported done.
A new task needs its completion criteria agreed up front.
Work is partly done and the remaining gap must be stated.
when_not_to_use: Planning or doing the work: use the stage skill.
Judging the quality of evidence in depth: use evidence-quality-gates.
prerequisites: The task, its acceptance criteria and its owner.
Access to the evidence the work produced.
Templates in templates/definition-of-done/ for the profile.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: checklist result per criterion (PASS, FAIL, WAIVED, BLOCKED)
list of open items with owners
closure statement or a not-done statement

decision_rules.action: Record reason, owner, expiry and approver.
Do not close; assign an owner or accept it explicitly.
Report what is done, what is not, and the next owner; do not call it done.

decision_rules.situation: Task spans profiles (e.g. API and database)
decision_rules.action: Apply both profiles and merge their criteria.

quality_gates: Each acceptance criterion has a result and evidence reference
Tests, security, operations and documentation are checked as the profile requires
Required approvals and handoffs are complete

examples.title: Close a bug fix
examples.request: Is the discount bug fix done?
examples.context: Fix merged, regression test added, not yet released.
examples.behavior: Apply the bug-fix profile: test fails before and passes after, review done, release pending.
examples.output: Not done: release and verification in production are open; owner assigned.
examples.acceptance: Closure is withheld until verification evidence exists.

examples.title: Select a profile
examples.request: Define done for the new reporting API.
examples.behavior: Combine the API and database-change profiles and list criteria for contract, tests, migration and rollback.
examples.output: Merged checklist with evidence required for each line.
examples.acceptance: No criterion is missing for either profile.

examples.title: Handle a waiver
examples.request: Accessibility check could not be run before launch.
examples.behavior: Record a WAIVED result with owner, reason and expiry, and add a follow-up.
examples.acceptance: Waiver has a named approver and an expiry date.

limitations: Judges completeness against stated criteria; it cannot know criteria nobody wrote.
Cannot verify evidence authenticity: that is evidence-quality-gates.
A human closes the work; it only reports readiness.

troubleshooting.resolution: Draft criteria with the owner before judging completion.
Mark BLOCKED and request the record.
Ask the owner or apply the stricter profile.

handoffs.artifact: evidence sets that need deeper evaluation
